title: Decision
description: The output of the cadence enforcer's decide() pure function. Tells the runtime adapter what action to take in response to an Event. Defined in CONTRACTS.md §3.3.

schema_version.description: Protocol schema version. MUST be '1.0' for this revision.

action.description: 'noop': no intervention required; 'inject': runtime SHOULD inject 'message' into the agent's next-turn context; 'block': runtime SHOULD prevent the triggering action from completing and present 'message' to the agent.

message.description: Human-readable message for 'inject' and 'block' actions. MUST be a non-empty string when action is 'inject' or 'block'. MUST be null when action is 'noop'.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason string for telemetry and debugging. Not presented to the agent.

examples.message: You have not checked the channels inbox in a while. Call {{recv_tool}} before continuing if you may be waiting on input.
Inbox not drained. Call {{recv_tool}} and integrate any messages before completing the task.
examples.reason: stop_requested with non-empty inbox and force_drain_on_stop=true
